description: Transformer oil temperature spike due to cooling fan relay fault. Replaced cooling fan relay and flushed oil reservoir.
Conveyor motor vibration caused by worn drive belt and misaligned pulley. Replaced belt and realigned drive assembly.
High bearing vibration alarm triggered. Dismantled motor housing
Chilled water pump mechanical seal leak and pressure drop. Replaced graphite mechanical seal and refilled coolant circuit.
Post-repair follow-up scan and oil level check. All parameters nominal.
Winding overheating alarm triggered under heavy load. Replaced secondary tap changer gasket and calibrated thermal protection relay.
Motor frame resonance and rotor imbalance. Performed dynamic field balancing and tightened foundation anchor bolts.
